findings.claim: The acceptance criterion that MessagePack attributes on T are honoured is not implemented. The collector never examines T's attributes and unconditionally builds string-keyed contractless members whenever no surrogate is supplied, so a referenced [MessagePackObject] type with integer [Key] members is serialized using its member names instead of its declared keys; DataContract/DataMember settings are likewise not consulted.

receipt_plan.detail: Compile ProjectA.MyObject in a metadata assembly with [MessagePackObject] and [Key(0)], then generate a body-less formatter for it as in GeneratedFormatterRequirementTests.Formatter_MessagePackAttributesOnReferencedType_AreHonored. The generated formatter currently calls WriteMapHeader rather than WriteArrayHeader, proving that the declared integer key is ignored.

findings.claim: Contractless field selection has the read-only test reversed: public mutable instance fields fail IsPublicReadWrite and are silently omitted, while public readonly fields pass and are subsequently modelled as writable. This violates the documented public read-write field behaviour; serialization loses mutable field values, and a type with a selected readonly field can produce invalid deserialization code.

receipt_plan.detail: Run GeneratedFormatterRequirementTests.BodylessFormatter_ReferencedType_UsesPublicReadWriteMembersContractlessly. Its referenced target has a public mutable Volume field and a read-write Label property; the current generated formatter contains Label but no .Volume access. A companion mutation changing IsReadOnly to !IsReadOnly should make that assertion pass.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Keep the added SurrogateType API and GenerateFormatterRequest surrogate pipeline: keys and membership can be supplied by a separate annotated surrogate, while a formatter without a surrogate uses contractless members. To satisfy the acceptance criteria, the no-surrogate path must additionally detect and honour attributes already present on T.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Implement only the attribute API named by the acceptance criteria: GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute has no SurrogateType property and the generator reads MessagePack attributes directly from T, falling back to contractless public read-write members when no MessagePackObject or DataContract attribute is present. The surrogate collection branch and MsgPack022 are omitted as unnecessary public surface.
